routes./: SuperApp shell (tab-based): Home feed, Map, SwipeMatch, Chat, Apps
routes./can-co: Legacy bảng tin — preserved for different UX purpose
routes./intent/[id]: Re-exports v1-split/page.tsx (V1-Split Mẫu D là route chính thức từ 2026-04-19)
routes./intent/[id]/v1-split: V1-Split source of truth — Dark Navy + Violet, sticky left (slider+map), scrollable right

layout.decision: Migrated from SidebarDesktop (vertical) to TopNavbar (horizontal) on 2026-04-18

design_system.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 shadow-sm (hover: shadow-md border-slate-200)
design_system.sticky_bar: top-16 (offset for TopNavbar h-16), bg-white/80 backdrop-blur
design_system.DEPRECATED: All var(--wm-*) CSS variables replaced with explicit Tailwind tokens as of 2026-04-18

features.name: TopNavbar
features.notes: Logo-left, 5 nav items center, Bell+Avatar right. Replaces SidebarDesktop.

features.name: Intent Detail /intent/[id] (Original)
features.notes: Original centered layout max-w-2xl. Kept as baseline.

features.name: Intent Detail V1 Split (Official)
features.notes: Mẫu D Dark Navy + Violet. Left panel sticky: top50% ImageSlider (dots+thumbnails), bottom50% Mapbox. Right panel scrollable: tags, title, violet price, 2x2 specs grid, poster info, mô tả chi tiết, tiện ích chips (buildAmenityChips from parsed_data), tin liên quan (real API by district+category). Sticky CTA bar (Gọi điện + Chat). /intent/[id] re-exports from v1-split/page.tsx.

features.name: Intent Detail /can-co/intent/[id]
features.notes: Same design system as above. Redesigned in previous session.

features.name: Homepage Sidebar + Grid Layout
features.notes: 3-col desktop layout: FeedFilterSidebar (left, sticky, type/district/price filters), 2-col grid feed (center), FeedObserverPanel (right, xl+). Filter logic client-side. Mobile: 1-col unchanged.

features.name: FeedTab VIP navigation
features.notes: VIP intents wrapped in Link, all intents now appear in feed.

features.name: Mutual Match (Swipe)
features.notes: Like/dislike swipe + Quan Tâm tab for inbound likes.

features.name: Bot Pipeline (Curator)
features.notes: RawNews → LLM Curator → Intent records. No-Hallucination rule.

known_issues: public/uploads/ chưa migrate lên cloud storage
hcm-wards.geojson ward-level choropleth chưa hoàn thiện
IntentComments component còn nằm trong file /intent/[id] nhưng disabled
Tiện ích chips hiển thị từ parsed_data.keywords (raw text). Các tin có cấu trúc parsedData (bedrooms, bathrooms, area) sẽ hiển thị chips đẹp hơn
Tin liên quan card image hiển thị ảnh từ DB — tin nào không có ảnh sẽ fallback violet gradient
